scripts.build: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo build --locked -p program-id' anchor && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:native: pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'cargo build --locked -p program-id' anchor && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.lint:rs: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings' anchor
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:rebuild && pnpm test:idl-shape
scripts.test:unit: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test --locked -p program-id --lib' anchor
